description: How an AI-found record was found, kept on the record it created. Optional on the target schema and set only by the server (a named function), never typed in a form. A record loaded by hand never has it. Defined once in schemas/discovery_mark.fragment.json and embedded unchanged in every schema an AI finder can create (check.py proves the copies match). A fact the record holds that is not listed in marks was not marked; a fact the AI did not know is simply absent from the record. Rules the schema cannot express: run_id names a discovery_run that exists; every key in marks names a field the record holds; a fact marked sure must have a source in source_urls (otherwise it is stored as verify).

run_id.description: The discovery run (batch) that found this record. Required.

model_name.description: The AI model that produced it, as named on the run, such as gemini-2.5-flash. Up to 100 characters. Required.

prompt_version.description: The version number of the published prompt used. Required.

found_at.description: When the AI result was received (UTC). Required.

source_urls.description: Web pages the AI cited for this record, up to 20, each up to 500 characters. Optional.

marks.description: How sure the AI was about each fact, by field name: sure (a source was cited) or verify (the AI thinks it is right but could not confirm it). A field with neither a value nor a mark is unknown. Optional.

needs_attention.description: true when a person should check this record before activating it, for example because it has no street address. Optional; absent means false.

attention_reasons.description: Why it needs attention, as short codes: no_street_address, address_not_matched (the free geocoder could not find the address), operator_unconfirmed (the business that runs it was guessed). Up to 10. Required when needs_attention is true.
